original_question: Which gene associated with Potocki–Lupski syndrome can also cause Smith–Magenis syndrome?

final_qi.question: Which gene associated with Potocki–Lupski syndrome can also cause Smith–Magenis syndrome?
final_qi.long_answer: Reference: [GG_18], [CRAWL_WIKI_1]. Detailed explanation: The provided context indicates that mutations or copy number alterations affecting the RAI1 gene are associated with neurodevelopmental disorders. Specifically, deletions of the RAI1 gene are a primary cause of Smith–Magenis syndrome, while duplications of the same gene are associated with Potocki–Lupski syndrome. Thus, the RAI1 gene is the common gene linked to both syndromes.
